link.unread: {count, plural, =0 {Chat, nothing new} one {Chat, # conversation with new messages} other {Chat, # conversations with new messages}}

list.title: Chat
list.empty: No conversations yet. Start one with “New conversation”.
list.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
list.choose: Choose a conversation, or start a new one.

start.title: New conversation
start.intro: You can write to members who are listed in the member directory. The person you write to sees your name.
start.empty: Nobody was found. Only members who are listed in the directory and accept messages can be found.
start.unavailable: This member can’t be written to.

cannot.membersOnly: Your account isn’t verified as a physician’s yet, so you can read your conversations but not send messages.
cannot.suspended: The association’s staff suspended you from sending messages. You can still read your conversations.
cannot.blocked: You blocked this person. Unblock them to send messages.
cannot.unavailable: This person’s account is no longer available.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends. Shift+Enter starts a new line.
composer.patientNote: Do not write details that identify a patient.
composer.left: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}

confirm.deleteAllText: Both of you will see “This message was deleted” in its place. This can’t be undone.
confirm.deleteMineText: It disappears from your side only. The other person still sees it.
confirm.blockText: Neither of you will be able to send messages to the other. They are not told that you blocked them.

details.title: Conversation details
details.profile: Open their page in the directory
details.notListed: This member is not listed in the directory.
details.muteForever: Muted until I switch it back

report.introMessage: The association’s staff will see this message with the five messages before and after it, and nothing else of the conversation.
report.introPerson: The association’s staff will see what you write here. They will not see the conversation.
report.sent: Thank you. Your report was sent to the association’s staff.

settings.title: Chat settings
settings.audience: Who can start a conversation with me
settings.audienceListed: Members, while I am listed in the member directory
settings.audienceNote: Conversations that already exist are not affected. To stop one, block the person.
settings.notListed: You are not listed in the member directory, so nobody can start a conversation with you. You can still write to others.
settings.readReceipts: Show others when I have read their messages
settings.readReceiptsHint: If you switch this off, you won’t see it for their messages either.
settings.typing: Show others when I am typing
settings.notifications: Emails about messages and the number on the Chat link are set in your notification preferences.

admin.title: Chat reports
admin.intro: Reports members sent about a message or a person. A report shows the reported message and the five before and after it. Conversations can’t be read from here, and every look at a report is recorded.

detail.title: Report
detail.messages: The reported message and the ones around it
detail.noMessages: This report is about a person. It carries no messages.
detail.erased: The kept copy of the messages was erased, 90 days after the report was closed.
detail.suspendedNow: This person is suspended from chat now.
detail.aboutRoom: This report is about the room as such. It carries no messages; open the room to see it.
detail.deleteRoomMessage: Remove the reported message from the room
detail.deleteMessage: Delete the reported message for both people
detail.suspend: Suspend the reported person from sending in chat
detail.daysHint: 1 to 365. Leave empty to suspend until it is lifted.
detail.own: You are one of the two people of this report, so a different administrator must decide on it.
detail.viewNote: Opening this report was recorded in the audit log.
